title: Settings live in a config file and a floating panel edits them
body:
decade's settings are constants in the source: `BAR_HOLD`, `GHOST_SCALE`, `GHOST_ALPHA` and `GRAB_ANIMATION` in `src/compositor.rs`, `FONT_PX` in `src/text.rs`, and the commands for the chat and code panes from the command line.

## Proposal

- decade reads `~/.config/decade/config.toml` at start. A missing file means the built-in values. A `version` key at the top is the format's version byte under CLAUDE.md's rule for on-disk formats.
- The Settings row in the palette closes the palette and opens a floating panel that lists each setting with its value. The panel edits a value in place and writes the file.
- The work goes on a branch named `settings`, since it adds an on-disk format and will likely not be finished before the next release.

## Open

- Which settings take effect at once, and which need a restart. The font size changes the cell grid, so it probably needs a restart.
close_reason: 3f10063 on the settings branch, merged into dev.
